name: Khopra Pattice
steps: Mash cooled potatoes with cornflour, cumin and 5 g salt until smooth. Mix coconut, cashews, raisins, chillies, coriander, lemon, sugar and remaining salt for the filling.
Divide potato mixture into 12 portions. Flatten each, place coconut filling in the centre, close completely and shape into thick oval patties.
Smooth any cracks in the potato casing with damp fingers, keeping the sweet coconut filling fully enclosed.
Fry in batches at 175°C for 4–5 minutes until evenly golden. Drain and serve with green chutney.
tips: Seal every seam with potato; exposed coconut can escape into the oil.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
